title: Algebraic expansivity on abelian groups
summary: Building on the author's earlier work on topological and abstract expansivity, this paper introduces and explores the notion of algebraic expansivity for endomorphisms of abelian groups. We analyze the fundamental properties of this algebraic analogue, establish its relationship with Weiss's algebraic entropy, and prove that positively expansive epimorphisms are necessarily restricted to finite systems.
